title: Rose's Modpack Optimized
description: a modpack for optimizing the game
body:
**Performance**
Rose's Modpack Optimized is faster than competing game clients, thanks to modern performance mods like Sodium, Lithium, and other perfomance mods.

**Built on Fabric**
Rose's Modpack Optimized uses the Fabric mod loader, which is lightweight, fast, and supports a lot of mods. You can use the modpack as a base to add your favorite mods tho.
